recent_weekly_summaries.thesis: This week, the technology sector continues to lead the market with strong momentum, driven by AI and semiconductor trends. Stocks with high upside targets and recent positive news, such as DELL, MU, FLEX, and DOCN, are attractive swing trade candidates. However, stocks with weak sector momentum and high downside targets, such as HUM, CBRL, and RXO, should be avoided. The recent macro events and upcoming earnings reports will also impact the market, making it essential to stay vigilant and adjust the portfolio accordingly.

Big Tech earnings week (MSFT July 29, AMZN July 30) as AI spend read-throughs. Action: CLOSE LLY (mandatory, earnings Aug 5-6, lock +17%), CLOSE FLEX (no AI catalyst), BUY MU re-entry (HBM4 sold out, oversold RSI 34.7, $1,087 analyst target, earnings Sept 23), BUY NVDA (laggard +10% YTD vs AMD +142%, direct MSFT/AMZN earnings catalyst, earnings Aug 26).
